The '''Seacroppers' Guild''' was an organization of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] that cultivated [[Algae/Legends|algae]] on the big oceans of [[Aquilaris Minor]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. They were also fishermen who hunted for eels and members of the Guild wore a uniform consisting of grey overalls and boots. They were very organized, using other a [[hyperspace transponder]] but when the [[Deluge]] was distributed on the planet the guild ceased to operate efficiently.

Following the [[Battle of Capital Cay]], the Seacroppers were "liberated" by [[Grace Command]]'s [[Devil Squadron]] led by former [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]]. While promising to distribute food and medical supplies, their true mission was to distribute more of the Deluge narcotic to undermine the Sith war effort. The Devil Squadron crew also requisitioned the Seacroppers' barracks and forcibly evicted the Seacroppers.

The organization was still active a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later. [[Annileen Calwell]] spent time on [[Capital Cay]] sometime prior to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], where she would enjoy watching the Seacroppers bring in their catch.<ref name="Kenobi novel">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
